mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier (name, contact_person, phone, address, credit_level, bank_account, remark, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{contactPerson}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{creditLevel}, #{bankAccount}, #{remark}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY name
